name: V-JEPA 2
summary: V-JEPA 2 pretrains on over a million hours of internet video by predicting masked latent representations rather than reconstructing pixels. An action-conditioned variant is then fine-tuned on a relatively small amount of unlabeled robot interaction and used for zero-shot planning: given a goal image, it searches action sequences whose predicted latent outcome matches the goal, enabling pick-and-place with new objects in new environments without task-specific training.
innovation: Joint-embedding predictive architecture applied to video, avoiding pixel reconstruction entirely.
Zero-shot goal-conditioned planning from a world model trained mostly on passive internet video.
matters: The leading non-generative alternative to video-diffusion world models, and far cheaper to run.
limits: Demonstrated on short-horizon tasks; goal specification by image is restrictive. Verify current results.
lineage: Value-equivalent and latent-prediction thinking applied to large-scale video pretraining.
